items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Ed Garland, some of the other members of the band.

ctx.x: He taught music when he was out there. He had an old boys and kids orchestra. Played in Hollywood. That's what he did in California, taught music.
We saw quite a few of the California musicians. Like Kidore is out there. Oh, yeah. He's out there. Ed Garland, some of the other members of the band. But I never knew your uncle.
I saw Bob Johnson before he died. Uncle took me to see him in Los Angeles. Got to see him after that. Yes, 1949.
